ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, \(l_1, l_2, l_3\) are a set of parallel lines, and the lines AC, DF intersect this set of parallel lines successively at points A, B, C, and D, E, F, respectively. If \(\frac{AB}{BC}=\frac{2}{3}\), then what is the value of \(\frac{EF}{DF}\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Since $l_1 \parallel l_2 \parallel l_3$, we have $\frac{EF}{DF}=\frac{BC}{AC}$. Furthermore, since $\frac{AB}{BC}=\frac{2}{3}$, it follows that $\frac{BC}{AC}=\frac{3}{5}$. Hence, $\frac{EF}{DF}=\boxed{\frac{3}{5}}$.
